title: Infineon wins fourth German patent ruling against Innoscience, as GaN fight flares in Shanghai
content: Germany's District Court Munich I ruled on July 3 that Innoscience infringed Infineon Technologies' gallium nitride (GaN) patents, barring the Chinese chipmaker from importing, selling, or marketing the affected products in Germany and ordering it to pay damages.
